With Veterans Affairs removed — 33% of these awards — the share still climbs from 5.9% at one to three months to
19.7% at eighteen to twenty-four, and still falls to 2.5% past three years. What that department does drive is
the short end: under a month it is 18.7% of all awards and 10.5% without it. The far end is partly mechanical —
99% of potential performance periods end within 1,826 days of the start, and past a three-year current term the
median room left to that line is 382 days. The linear summary a reader reaches for, -0.02, is the wrong summary
for this shape — though the size of a gap does track duration, at +0.48.

USAspending API v2 bulk download, fetched 2026-09-22; FY2016 with FY2015 as the replication. CAVEAT: current duration is measured after exercise, so a long term may be a
long base period or a short one whose options were taken; the duration panel drops the 10.9% of awards whose start falls after their own end. These eleven civilian
departments are 8.5% of federal contract awards; Defense (68.6%) is absent, so this is not federal procurement as a whole.
